title: The WP Visitor Statistics (Real Time Traffic) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via…
description: The WP Visitor Statistics (Real Time Traffic) plugin for WordPress up to version 8.9.0 is vulnerable to a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) flaw. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of the 'os' parameter (and related parameters 'browser' and 'res'). An unauthenticated attacker can inject malicious scripts that execute when a user views the affected page.
